result.mechanism: go build ./... links every main package to a disposable output on every invocation. Named outputs are real retained binaries whose embedded Go build IDs let an unchanged warm build skip linking. Separating the whole-tree gate removes 147 unrelated command links from make build without removing them from make ci.
